cells.effect: Different from QUEUED; retention expiry returns unknown/expired metadata where known, not a fabricated pending job.
cells.owner: Lookup without existing unexpired result or dispatch receipt

cells.effect: Persist task + due index + stable attempt key in one partition; scheduler later publishes and marks dispatch intent delivered.
cells.owner: Producer or retry coordinator; eta in future; accepted schedule record

cells.effect: Broker entry exists. Result projection may lag; queue receipt alone does not guarantee terminal result availability.
cells.owner: Publish confirmed or producer receipt reconciled

cells.effect: Lease owner/token/expiry and attempt state atomic; another live claim cannot execute; heartbeat extends only matching token.
cells.owner: Consumer obtains CAS claim with new fencing token

cells.effect: Atomic RETRY_WAIT plus successor intent; increment retries separately from broker deliveries. Keep stable task ID; relay to schedule/broker; durable source record survives worker interruption.
cells.owner: Explicit Retry or configured AutoRetryFor; max_retries and lifetime permit

cells.effect: Atomic terminal state/result + callback/child-completion intent; broker acknowledgement happens later. Redelivery sees terminal and only acknowledges.
cells.owner: Current lease token; handler returned valid result

cells.effect: Sanitized error/result metadata and errback intent persisted; chord member failed exactly once logically; ack after persistence.
cells.owner: Current token; permanent failure or exhausted retries

cells.effect: Persist terminal revocation + completion intent. Running side effects may already have occurred; force kill cannot roll them back.
cells.owner: Revocation observed before claim or cooperative handler acknowledged cancel

cells.effect: Persist terminal expiration and workflow notification; remove/ack queue entry only after terminal state confirmed.
CAS increments fence; abandoned attempt reclaimed under max-attempt/loss policy. Old worker cannot write authoritative terminal state; duplicate external effects still possible.
cells.owner: Recovery scanner sees Redis-time expiry and no current owner

cells.effect: Progress payload bounded, cannot override terminal status; updates versioned and may be sampled; progress read authorized.
Release large result first; dedupe fence/tombstone survives replay horizon; chord records retain until children settled; never delete active coordination state.
cells.owner: Retention worker after result/workflow safety horizon
